name: ISSUER_IDENTITY_EXACT
findings: SAN: issuer=BANCO SANTANDER, S.A., NIF=A39000013, LEI=5493006QMFDDMYWIAM13 (GLEIF ACTIVE).
BBVA: issuer=BANCO BILBAO VIZCAYA ARGENTARIA, S.A., NIF=A48265169, LEI=K8MS7FD7N5Z2WQ51AZ71 (GLEIF ACTIVE, ES).
IBE: issuer=IBERDROLA, S.A., NIF=A-48010615, LEI=5QK37QC7NWOJ8D7WVQ45 (GLEIF ACTIVE).
CNMV NIF is the authoritative registry key; GLEIF LEI is the global entity identifier; mapping established by legal entity name + jurisdiction.
issuer != security: a security (share/ISIN) is distinct from the issuer; ISIN must not be primary issuer identity.
Subsidiaries/branches (BBVA Colombia/Uruguay, IBERDROLA France/Renouvelables) are excluded from issuer identity.
GLEIF filter[entity.legalName] requires a clean name (no trailing punctuation); filter[lei] returns exactly one record.
limitations: NIF<->LEI mapping is by name+jurisdiction match (GLEIF records do not carry the CNMV NIF directly); cross-checked for SAN via the issuer's own ESEF filing.
The LEI registration-authority fields were not populated by the API response shape used here.
